t: Camping at the Gorge this summer? Pack these 5 tips from festival veterans | The Seattle Times
s: May 27, 2023 - A blazing day at the Gorge can end with a cold night of camping. Jones said it’s important to prepare clothing according to the temperature. In the daytime, people wear shorts and tank tops, while at night, the wind picks up and folks wear sweatshirts (and silly animal onesies). Jones said she typically buys VIP passes at the amphitheater, allowing her to skip the general admission lines and go freely out of the venue so she can bring supplies with her as it turns to the evening, including warmer clothing.
